name: singlet_normalization_count_noise_model_selection
title: Count noise-model selection and zero-inflation diagnosis
description: Chooses a count family per gene (Poisson, negative binomial or zero-inflated negative binomial) from negative controls when present, otherwise from a depth-only null, and writes dispersion, zero-inflation and calibration members. Use it before choosing a variance model or normalisation. Do not use it to correct or replace counts: layers/counts is read and never modified.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Raw integer count layer to model; normalised or log-transformed values are rejected.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for negative-control simulation; 42 matches the repository setting.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

families.description: Candidate families, simplest first. The depth-only multinomial null is always reported.

method.description: auto uses negative_control when uns/negative_control/counts exists, otherwise deviance.

stratify_by.description: Optional obs column, such as cell type; families are selected within each level.

min_detected_cells.description: Genes detected in fewer cells are skipped before any fit, in controls and data alike.

negative_control.description: Options for control calibration; used only when negative_control or auto finds control counts.

max_iter.description: Iterations for per-gene dispersion maximum likelihood.

theta_clip.description: Dispersion estimates above this value are reported as diverged.

n_simulations.description: Simulated control datasets per true dispersion.

n_means_simulated.description: Log-spaced gene means in each simulated control.

sim_thetas.description: Finite true dispersions to simulate; the Poisson case is always added.

zinb.description: Options for the zero-inflation test; used only when zinb is in families.

lrt_alpha.description: Significance level of the boundary-corrected likelihood-ratio test of ZINB against NB.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. varm/count_family. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Completed runs only: keys method, n_genes, n_cells, family_counts, median_R0, fraction_zinb_selected, and per_stratum when stratify_by is set.

provenance_id.description: Provenance record id appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
